charterSource: JBT0.2 fixes the required workflow population; a workflow absent from this matrix is not required, and a required workflow absent from a candidate is a parity gap
stateRules: parity, gap, partial, unsupported and pending are distinct states and never collapse into one another or into a success theater row
every state is per comparator row (default vs alternate official mode) and per pinned corpus; a workflow parity on a different basis is not evidence

workflows.officialBaseline: official default-mode completion in .vue/.ts web sources, scoped by the manifest pins
workflows.passPredicate: the adapter's completion answers the same trigger positions with typed items whose types come from the TypeScript semantic rail
nonRegressionConditions: no completion item types fabricated outside the semantic rail
no trigger positions the official tool answers and the adapter silently drops

workflows.officialBaseline: official default-mode diagnostics and error reporting
workflows.passPredicate: diagnostics at least as correct as the official baseline on the pinned corpus, from the TypeScript semantic rail
nonRegressionConditions: no dropped diagnostics and no weakened typing to meet timing
diagnostic severity/scope never narrowed relative to the official baseline

workflows.officialBaseline: go to definition/declaration navigation in templates, scripts and web sources
workflows.passPredicate: navigation targets resolve through authored coordinates on the same positions the official tool resolves
nonRegressionConditions: generated coordinates are never passed off as authored coordinates
no navigation target silently unsupported where the official tool navigates

workflows.officialBaseline: find usages across project sources including template usages
workflows.passPredicate: usage population matches the official baseline's on the pinned corpus with authored-coordinate hits
nonRegressionConditions: usages computed by regex/name matching are forbidden
no usages population silently narrowed to script-only

workflows.officialBaseline: generic component/type support in the official default mode
workflows.passPredicate: generic specialization and inference preserved through the TypeScript semantic rail on the pinned corpus
nonRegressionConditions: no generic collapse to any/never to reduce work
specialization answers stay typed, not stringified

workflows.officialBaseline: public type surfaces (props/emits/exposed types) surfaced by the official tool
workflows.passPredicate: public types resolved from the canonical projection and surfaced through the adapter
nonRegressionConditions: no public type replaced by a synthesized approximate shape
type answers keep semantic-rail authority

workflows.passPredicate: extraction produces compilable results through authored, atomic edits
nonRegressionConditions: cross-file edits are authored, version-checked and atomic through the existing transaction authority
no partial extraction published as complete

workflows.officialBaseline: official rename/move with import updates across web sources
workflows.passPredicate: rename/move updates the same population the official tool updates, through the edit transaction authority
nonRegressionConditions: textual rename without semantic resolution is forbidden
no stale references left in files the official tool updates

workflows.passPredicate: formatting routes through the owning format logic with stable idempotent output on the pinned corpus
nonRegressionConditions: no formatter output divergence introduced by presentation-layer reformatting
formatting never edits authored coordinates without source maps

workflows.officialBaseline: official inlay hints in web sources
workflows.passPredicate: inlay values typed by the semantic rail and rendered on the client surface
nonRegressionConditions: inlay types never fabricated outside the semantic rail
reduced client capabilities degrade presentation, not meaning

workflows.officialBaseline: official style support (style blocks, navigation, completion in styles)
workflows.passPredicate: style support served by the owning CSS analysis through the adapter
nonRegressionConditions: no second CSS parser inside the client
style diagnostics never dropped relative to the official baseline

workflows.officialBaseline: official run/debug workflows for web development preserved through the adapter
workflows.passPredicate: existing run/debug workflows keep working with the adapter installed; JBT8 owns the preserved-workflow qualification
nonRegressionConditions: unexplained removal or degradation of an official workflow is forbidden
debug mappings stay authored, never generated-coordinate stand-ins

promotionGate.rule: product promotion requires parity-or-better on every required workflow row, qualified by JBT9 on the pinned corpus
promotionGate.note: a missing required official workflow blocks promotion even when Verter is faster on every measured row (JBT0-AC3)
promotionGate.voidResults: a performance result obtained by doing less required work on any row is void and is an abort condition for the claiming node
